dossier.purpose: ccusage is a local CLI that parses the usage records coding-agent CLIs write to disk and reports tokens and estimated API-equivalent cost by day, week, month, session and Claude 5-hour block (README.md:24,62; docs/guide/index.md:20-35). It does not modify agent logs, but it does write small caches. The production CLI is a Rust binary shipped through npm platform packages and a Nix flake (AGENTS.md:28-31). For the Claude Code + Codex usage question: one binary reads Claude Code transcripts (~/.claude/projects, ~/.config/claude/projects, or CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR) and Codex session logs (~/.codex/sessions plus archived_sessions, or CODEX_HOME). It reports input, output, cache-creation and cache-read tokens per agent or merged; for Codex, cache-creation is populated only when the record carries it (rust/adapters/claude/src/paths.rs:23-55; rust/adapters/codex/src/paths.rs:31-64,226-238; rust/crates/ccusage-core/src/types.rs:28-96; rust/adapters/codex/src/types.rs:282-328). It reads 16 other agents too. It has no feature for supplying task context, keeping recoverable originals, or measuring artifact/context reductions; it reports only provider-recorded usage.

claims.claim: Tagline: 'Analyze coding (agent) CLI token usage and costs from local data.'

'ccusage reads local usage data from coding agent CLIs and turns it into daily, weekly, monthly, and session reports.' The supported-sources table lists 18 sources, including Claude Code (`ccusage claude daily`) and Codex (`ccusage codex daily`).
'Use `ccusage daily`, `ccusage weekly`, `ccusage monthly`, or `ccusage session` to include every detected source in one report.'
'Cache Token Support: Tracks and displays cache creation and cache read tokens separately'

'JSON Output: Export data in structured JSON format with `--json`'; 'Cost Tracking: Shows costs in USD for each day/month/session'; 'Cost Hiding: Remove cost columns and JSON cost fields with `--no-cost`'
'Offline Mode: Use pre-cached pricing data without network connectivity with `--offline`'
'Custom Pricing Overrides: Override token pricing per raw model name in `ccusage.json` without rebuilding'

Claude Code-specific commands: `blocks` = 'Claude Code 5-hour billing windows'; `statusline` = 'Claude Code status line for hooks (Beta)'; feature list: 'Statusline Integration: Compact usage display for Claude Code status bar hooks (Beta)'
Quick start is `npx ccusage@latest`; package runners (`bunx`, `pnpm dlx`, `pnpx`, `nix run github:ccusage/ccusage -- daily`) run it without a global install; PR preview builds come from pkg.pr.new

'Nix builds embed the LiteLLM pricing file from the locked `litellm` flake input, so sandboxed builds do not fetch pricing at build time.' 'Non-Nix Cargo builds read the same locked LiteLLM revision from `flake.lock` and fetch the pricing file from that revision at build time.'
'The scheduled `update pricing` workflow runs the same update and validation, then opens a PR when the pricing snapshot changes.'

Sponsor blurb: 'Lineman.io — a Team & Enterprise solution for Claude Code: 40% lower token usage, full teams spend visibility, and unauthorized-spend alerts.' (advertisement for a different product, not a ccusage statement)

Contributor setup uses the Nix flake dev shell with nix-direnv and `just` recipes (`just fmt`, `just test`, `just check`); the dev shell provides the pinned pnpm, Rust toolchain, git hooks and project utilities
Documentation lives at ccusage.com; the license is MIT (c) @ryoppippi

install.method: Nix flake run (README also documents `nix build github:ccusage/ccusage`)
npm global install (docs also list `yarn global add ccusage` and `pnpm add -g ccusage`)

platforms.gpu: no - CPU-only log analyzer; no GPU/CUDA/Metal code or docs found (a search for cuda/gpu/metal/nvidia matched only an unrelated comment in nix/tools/models-dev-gen/compact.ts:33 and a catalog name in rust/crates/ccusage-core/src/models-dev-catalog-rules.json:25).

integrations.cli: yes - `ccusage` bin (apps/ccusage/package.json:17-19) -> src/cli.js spawns the native binary with inherited stdio and forwards signals (apps/ccusage/src/cli.js:162-258). Subcommands: daily, monthly, weekly, session, blocks, statusline and per-agent namespaces such as `claude` and `codex` (rust/crates/ccusage/src/main.rs:25-67); with no subcommand it runs the unified daily report (main.rs:53-65). Output is a table or `--json`; `--jq <filter>` pipes the JSON through an external `jq` process (rust/crates/ccusage-cli-parser/src/parser.rs:771; rust/crates/ccusage-core/src/output.rs:158-168). Filters: --since/--until/--last, --timezone, --mode auto|calculate|display, --offline, --breakdown, --instances/--project, --sections, --by-agent (docs/guide/cli-options.md:9-257).
integrations.mcp: none found - no MCP server in code or docs. The only 'mcp' hits are contributor tooling: .mcp.json:2-10 (remote context7 and grep.app servers for repo-local agents) and a permission entry `mcp__sentry__*` in .claude/settings.json:4.
integrations.sdk_or_api: none found - no library/SDK or HTTP server. The npm package ships only the bin launcher and config-schema.json (apps/ccusage/package.json:17-23); apps/ccusage/AGENTS.md:7-9 states the public surface is the `ccusage` command, its subcommands and stable `--json` output, 'not library-style TypeScript exports'; the Rust crates are `publish = false` (rust/Cargo.toml:14). The only network code is the pricing client (rust/crates/ccusage/src/http.rs). Programmatic use is subprocess + `--json` (docs/guide/json-output.md:578-681); a JSON Schema for the config file is shipped (apps/ccusage/config-schema.json).
integrations.claude_code_or_codex: Claude Code: yes. (1) Reads Claude Code JSONL transcripts (rust/adapters/claude/README.md:14-16; rust/adapters/claude/src/paths.rs:23-55). (2) `ccusage statusline` is built to be Claude Code's `statusLine` command: it reads the hook JSON (session_id, transcript_path, model, cost, context_window, effort) from stdin (rust/crates/ccusage/src/commands/mod.rs:310-327,921-951); settings.json snippet at docs/guide/statusline.md:17-31; offline by default (rust/crates/ccusage-cli/src/types.rs:220-224); it keeps an output cache in the OS temp dir (commands/mod.rs:860-877). (3) `ccusage blocks` reports Claude 5-hour windows (commands/mod.rs:262-308; rust/crates/ccusage-core/src/lib.rs:55). Codex: data source only - reads ${CODEX_HOME:-~/.codex}/sessions and archived_sessions (rust/adapters/codex/src/paths.rs:31-64,226-238; rust/adapters/codex/src/README.md:3-11) with `--speed auto|standard|fast` pricing (docs/guide/codex/index.md:40,66-83); docs label Codex support experimental (docs/guide/codex/index.md:5). No end-user plugin, hook or skill for either tool; the repo's .claude/, .codex/ and .agents/skills/ are contributor dev-environment config (.claude/AGENTS.md:1-5; .codex/environments/environment.toml:1-17).

readme.telemetry_and_network: No telemetry, analytics or crash-reporting code found (a repo-wide search for telemetry/analytics/sentry/posthog/tracking matched only docs about Copilot CLI's own OpenTelemetry files that ccusage reads, docs/guide/copilot/index.md:3-5,27). Docs claim '100% Local', 'No Data Transmission', 'Read-Only' (docs/guide/index.md:141-146). Runtime network use is limited to pricing refresh: unless `--offline` or `--mode display`, the binary GETs LiteLLM's model_prices_and_context_window.json from raw.githubusercontent.com and, lazily for models still unpriced, https://models.dev/api.json (rust/crates/ccusage-core/src/pricing.rs:54-56,977-1013,1452-1467; the Claude loader skips pricing in display mode: rust/adapters/claude/src/lib.rs:144-152). The client is ureq+rustls with a 10 s timeout, a 64 MiB cap and only an If-None-Match request header (rust/crates/ccusage/src/http.rs:11-12,75-86); ETag-validated bodies are cached under $XDG_CACHE_HOME/ccusage/http-cache or ~/.cache/ccusage/http-cache (http.rs:22-24,36-52,199-229). Failures fall back silently to the pricing snapshot embedded in the binary (warnings only at LOG_LEVEL>=4: pricing.rs:996-1002,2690-2692). `statusline` defaults to offline (rust/crates/ccusage-cli/src/types.rs:220-224) and writes a per-session file under the OS temp dir ccusage-semaphore/<session>.lock (commands/mod.rs:860-877). No account, API key or login is required or read by the code (no auth header: http.rs:79-82). `--jq` spawns a local jq (output.rs:162-168). Package runners (npx, bunx, pnpm dlx) also contact the npm registry to fetch the package and its platform binary (README.md:57,101-102; apps/ccusage/package.json:32-39). Build time: the `fetch-litellm-pricing` feature downloads the LiteLLM snapshot (rust/crates/ccusage-core/build.rs:83-104; used by Windows release builds: .github/actions/build-windows-native-package/action.yaml:17-21); Nix builds read it from the pinned flake input (README.md:237).

languages: TypeScript (tests, fixture generator, Nix-built tooling, docs config)

entry_points.what: npm `bin` launcher: maps platform/arch to @ccusage/ccusage-<platform>-<arch>, chmods and spawns bin/ccusage with inherited stdio, forwards signals, exits 1 with a message if the native package is missing (cli.js:27-109,233-262).
Native `ccusage` binary main (bin target: rust/crates/ccusage/Cargo.toml:8-10); installs the HTTP pricing fetcher and dispatches subcommands; no subcommand = unified daily report (main.rs:25-67).
Claude-namespaced daily/monthly/weekly/session/blocks reports and the `statusline` hook command (reads Claude Code hook JSON on stdin).
Unified multi-agent `run` (all detected sources, --sections, --by-agent); loads the Claude and Codex adapters among 18 (loader.rs:120-127).
Claude Code loader: load_entries / load_daily_summaries, dedupe of copied and sidechain-replayed records (paths.rs, daily.rs alongside).
Codex adapter run/report_json; parser.rs reads token_count events, replay.rs handles forked/subagent replay, speed.rs resolves service tier.
Generates apps/ccusage/config-schema.json; drift is a flake check (nix/checks.nix:86-117).

code.architecture: Rust-first Cargo workspace (rust/Cargo.toml:7; 27 member crates: 19 under adapters/, 8 under crates/; edition 2024; publish=false; pinned toolchain 1.97.1, rust-toolchain.toml:2). apps/ccusage is only the npm shell: launcher, config-schema.json, packaging and benchmark scripts (AGENTS.md:28-31; apps/ccusage/AGENTS.md:3-9). Key modules: rust/crates/ccusage (binary: main.rs dispatch, commands/mod.rs, blocks.rs, http.rs pricing fetcher, adapter/ aliases); rust/crates/ccusage-cli (option types) and ccusage-cli-parser (hand-written parser; help data in cli-help.json/cli-commands.json via build.rs and help_codegen.rs); ccusage-config (config files and JSON-schema generator); ccusage-core (pricing.rs = embedded LiteLLM + models.dev snapshots with optional live refresh, cost.rs, summary.rs, output.rs JSON/table shaping, build.rs embeds deflated snapshots); ccusage-terminal (table rendering); ccusage-adapter-all (unified report); 18 per-agent crates under rust/adapters/<agent> (claude, codex, opencode, amp, droid, codebuff, hermes, pi, goose, openclaw, kilo, kimi, qwen, copilot, gemini, antigravity, grok, zcode; names in ccusage-core/src/lib.rs:59-78) plus rust/adapters/common (recursive *.jsonl discovery, size-balanced chunking, parallel ordered reads: common/src/lib.rs:14-31). Claude adapter: lib.rs (loader, dedupe), daily.rs (narrower daily parser), paths.rs (discovery, --since mtime pruning). Codex adapter: parser.rs, loader.rs, aggregate.rs, replay.rs, speed.rs, report.rs. Flow: discover JSONL/SQLite files -> parse and dedupe -> price (embedded snapshot, optional refresh) -> aggregate -> table or JSON. Release profile: opt-level z, fat LTO, panic=abort, stripped (rust/Cargo.toml:70-78); mimalloc on linux-musl (rust/crates/ccusage/Cargo.toml:54-57); SQLite is bundled (rust/Cargo.toml:65) for adapters that read SQLite stores (not Claude or Codex).
code.packaging_and_release: Artifacts: npm package `ccusage` (launcher + config-schema.json only: apps/ccusage/package.json:20-23) and six platform packages @ccusage/ccusage-{darwin,linux,win32}-{arm64,x64}, each shipping one native binary (packages/*/package.json; apps/ccusage/package.json:32-39). The Nix flake exposes `ccusage` as default package/app (nix/packages.nix:50-70; README.md:229-235). Release flow (.github/workflows/release.yaml, workflow name 'tagpr'): tagpr opens and tags release PRs (lines 19-42; .tagpr); a 6-target build matrix (lines 49-112: linux arm64/x64 via musl-static Nix build verified static in CI, macOS arm64 native and x64 cross-built, Windows x64/arm64 via cargo with --features fetch-litellm-pricing); then `pnpm ... publish --provenance --no-git-checks --access public` with `id-token: write` (lines 114-151), i.e. npm provenance attestation; then changelogithub creates the GitHub release notes (lines 153-172). Binaries move between jobs as workflow artifacts (.github/actions/build-*-native-package/action.yaml); no checksum/SHA256SUMS or detached signature files were found and no workflow step uploads binaries to the GitHub release. PRs publish preview packages via pkg.pr.new for 5 of the 6 targets (ci.yaml:285). Third-party actions are pinned by commit SHA.

claim_checks.claim: Reads Claude Code and Codex local logs and tracks input, output, cache-creation and cache-read tokens separately (README.md:24,62,66-67,188)
claim_checks.evidence: Claude: claude_paths finds CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or ~/.config/claude + ~/.claude with a projects/ dir (rust/adapters/claude/src/paths.rs:23-55); every *.jsonl is scanned recursively (rust/adapters/common/src/lib.rs:14-31); fields input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens (rust/crates/ccusage-core/src/types.rs:28-39); cache creation uses the 5m+1h `cache_creation` breakdown when present (types.rs:41-50); separate counters (types.rs:67-96; adapters/claude/src/daily.rs:634-637); advisor iterations are counted under their own model (rust/adapters/claude/src/README.md:52-61); duplicate and sidechain-replayed records are deduplicated (README.md:19-42; adapters/claude/src/lib.rs:198-260). Codex: CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex with sessions/ and archived_sessions/ (rust/adapters/codex/src/paths.rs:31-64,226-238); event_msg/token_count uses last_token_usage or deltas of cumulative total_token_usage (parser.rs:318-332; src/README.md:13-19); maps input, cached_input (cache read), output (reasoning is a subset) and total, and fills cache-creation only if the record has cache_write_input_tokens or cache_creation_input_tokens (types.rs:282-328). Codex report `inputTokens` is non-cached input while `totalTokens` is the recorded total (report.rs:64-90,123-129). Table output shows cache columns only on wide terminals (docs/guide/getting-started.md:87-92,153-154); JSON always includes them (docs/guide/json-output.md:297-310).

claim_checks.claim: Default/unified reports cover every detected source, so Claude Code and Codex appear together (README.md:85)
claim_checks.evidence: No subcommand builds a Daily AgentCommandArgs and runs adapter::all::run (rust/crates/ccusage/src/main.rs:53-65); the unified loader runs the Claude and Codex adapters among 18 (rust/crates/ccusage-adapter-all/src/loader.rs:120-127; rust/crates/ccusage-core/src/lib.rs:59-78); --by-agent adds a per-agent split in JSON (ccusage-adapter-all/src/lib.rs:38-70; docs/guide/json-output.md:71). Note: the `claude`-namespaced reports use a separate Claude-only implementation titled 'Claude Code Token Usage Report' (rust/crates/ccusage/src/commands/mod.rs:33-70,146-181).

claim_checks.claim: Offline Mode uses 'pre-cached pricing data' (README.md:189; docs/guide/index.md:69)
claim_checks.evidence: Code: --offline skips the network and uses the pricing snapshot compiled into the binary (built from the pinned LiteLLM snapshot, built-in tables and an embedded models.dev snapshot), not a runtime cache (rust/crates/ccusage-core/src/pricing.rs:964-975,977-1013). The on-disk HTTP cache is only used after a server 304 (rust/crates/ccusage/src/http.rs:22-24). The embedded LiteLLM part is filtered to claude-/anthropic/gpt-/openai/azure/zai/openrouter-openai ids (rust/crates/ccusage-core/build.rs:200-214), so freshness equals the release date.

claim_checks.claim: '100% Local', 'No Data Transmission - Your usage data never leaves your computer', 'Read-Only - ccusage only reads files, never modifies them' (docs/guide/index.md:143-146)
claim_checks.evidence: No code path uploads usage data: the only outbound requests are GETs to two fixed pricing URLs with just an If-None-Match header (rust/crates/ccusage/src/http.rs:75-86; pricing.rs:54-56). But by default (not --offline, not display mode) it does contact raw.githubusercontent.com and models.dev (pricing.rs:977-1013; adapters/claude/src/lib.rs:144-152), and it writes caches: HTTP cache (http.rs:199-229) and statusline cache in the OS temp dir (rust/crates/ccusage/src/commands/mod.rs:860-877). Agent log files are only read.

The string CCUSAGE_OFFLINE appears only in that doc; no code reads it (repo-wide search). Offline is set by `--offline`/`-O` (rust/crates/ccusage-cli-parser/src/parser.rs:225,766), config-file `offline` (rust/crates/ccusage-config/src/config.rs:595-599) or the statusline default (rust/crates/ccusage-cli/src/types.rs:223). The runtime env vars the code does read include CCUSAGE_MODEL_ALIASES (rust/crates/ccusage-core/src/model_aliases.rs:8), which the docs do not mention. Code wins.

claim_checks.claim: JSON output has a 'Stable schema' and the documented shapes are accurate (README.md:185; docs/guide/json-output.md:285-473,690)
claim_checks.evidence: The daily example (`daily` + `totals`, json-output.md:297-320) matches code (rust/crates/ccusage/src/commands/mod.rs:52-55). The monthly, session and blocks examples use `type`/`data`/`summary` and `costUSD` (json-output.md:385-473) but the code emits `monthly`/`weekly` + `totals` (commands/mod.rs:94-97), `sessions` + `totals` (164-167) and a bare `blocks` array (291-293). docs/guide/cli-options.md:266,269 and json-output.md:618-621 use `.data[]` / data['data'] that the code does not produce. Per-agent shapes also differ: focused Codex rows use `costUSD` (rust/adapters/codex/src/report.rs:88,179) while Claude/unified rows use `totalCost` (rust/crates/ccusage-core/src/output.rs:34,66,110). Code wins.

claim_checks.claim: `blocks` = Claude Code 5-hour windows and `statusline` works as a Claude Code status-bar hook (README.md:120-121,175)

claim_checks.claim: Sponsor line: Lineman.io '40% lower token usage' (README.md:37)
claim_checks.evidence: A sponsor advertisement for a different product; no measurement or code in this repo corresponds to it. ccusage itself has no token-reduction feature (a search for savings/reduction/compress in rust/ and docs/ finds only the pricing-snapshot deflate in rust/crates/ccusage-core/build.rs:60 and pricing.rs:34).

risks: Scope: ccusage measures only provider-recorded usage and API-equivalent cost estimates; nothing in the code or docs supplies task context, keeps recoverable originals, or measures artifact/context reductions (search for savings/reduction/compress finds only pricing-snapshot deflate: rust/crates/ccusage-core/build.rs:60, pricing.rs:34). It will not estimate tokens from text (docs/guide/source-support-qa.md:3-5) and excludes tool/Web Search API calls (docs/guide/index.md:152-154). The README sponsor line about '40% lower token usage' (README.md:37) advertises another product, not a ccusage feature.

Input data is vendor-owned and unversioned: Codex support is self-described experimental (docs/guide/codex/index.md:5) and its parser carries many compatibility shims for changing record shapes (rust/adapters/codex/src/types.rs:250-328; rust/adapters/codex/src/README.md:21-36); Claude Code may keep logs only 30 days by default (docs/guide/claude/index.md:33-34); totals depend on dedupe/replay heuristics for sidechain and copied records (rust/adapters/claude/src/README.md:19-42; rust/adapters/codex/src/README.md:30-36).

Cost figures are estimates: models with no known price count as $0 (docs/guide/json-output.md:34); Codex rows using the gpt-5 or codex-auto-review fallbacks are flagged isFallback (rust/adapters/codex/src/README.md:46-48); --offline prices from the snapshot compiled into the binary, whose LiteLLM part covers only claude-/anthropic/gpt-/openai/azure/zai/openrouter-openai ids (rust/crates/ccusage-core/build.rs:200-214), so its freshness is the release date; docs say costs 'may not reflect actual billing' (docs/guide/index.md:154).

Network contact by default despite the 'No Data Transmission' wording: unless --offline or --mode display, runs fetch pricing from raw.githubusercontent.com and, lazily, models.dev (rust/crates/ccusage-core/src/pricing.rs:54-56,977-1013,1452-1467; docs/guide/index.md:141-146); the documented CCUSAGE_OFFLINE variable is not read by any code (docs/guide/environment-variables.md:124-131).

JSON contract is not uniform and docs disagree with code: focused Codex rows use `costUSD` (rust/adapters/codex/src/report.rs:88,179) while Claude/unified rows use `totalCost` (rust/crates/ccusage-core/src/output.rs:34,66,110); docs show `type`/`data`/`summary` shapes and `.data[]` jq examples (docs/guide/json-output.md:385-473,618-621; docs/guide/cli-options.md:266) that the code does not emit (rust/crates/ccusage/src/commands/mod.rs:94-97,164-167,291-293). Consumers should validate against actual output.

Supply chain and verification: the documented quick start runs whatever is latest on npm each time (README.md:57; docs/guide/installation.md:149-151); the native binary arrives through per-platform optionalDependencies and the launcher exits 1 if it is missing (apps/ccusage/src/cli.js:93-109); the only release attestation found is npm provenance (.github/workflows/release.yaml:123,151); no checksum or signature files and no SECURITY policy file were found.

Build from source: plain `cargo build` panics unless CCUSAGE_PRICING_JSON_PATH is set or the `fetch-litellm-pricing` feature is enabled (rust/crates/ccusage-core/build.rs:74-86); the contributor workflow assumes Nix + direnv + just (README.md:206-225); Windows release builds download pricing at build time (.github/actions/build-windows-native-package/action.yaml:17-21); toolchain pinned to Rust 1.97.1 (rust-toolchain.toml:2).

Maintenance and licensing: fast-moving surface (version 20.0.26; live monitor removed in v18, docs/guide/live-monitoring.md:5-7; standalone wrapper packages removed, AGENTS.md:41-43); an hourly bot commits pricing locks straight to main, contrary to README.md:245 (.github/workflows/update-pricing.yaml:5,74-80); new-contributor issues/PRs pass an automated gate run with Pullfrog agents (CONTRIBUTING.md:13-19,77-79); copyright and package author name a single individual (LICENSE:3; apps/ccusage/package.json:10); statically linked binaries bundle about 125 third-party crates (rust/Cargo.lock: 152 packages incl. 27 workspace crates) and no NOTICE/third-party license file was found.

checks.statement: npx (npm package runner; needs Node): `npx ccusage@latest`
checks.note: README.md:57 and :95 both read `npx ccusage@latest`. The npm package is named `ccusage` with bin `ccusage` -> ./src/cli.js (apps/ccusage/package.json:2,17-19). The launcher is a `#!/usr/bin/env node` script (apps/ccusage/src/cli.js:1), so Node is required. It resolves the native binary from six optionalDependencies (package.json:32-39). CI E2E runs `npx --yes <preview-url>` on every OS runner (.github/workflows/ci.yaml:412).

LICENSE:1-3 is the standard MIT text, 'Copyright (c) 2025 ryoppippi'. apps/ccusage/LICENSE (shipped inside the npm package) is identical. "license": "MIT" appears in apps/ccusage/package.json:9 and packages/ccusage-linux-x64/package.json:5. README.md:269 agrees. No other LICENSE/COPYING/NOTICE files exist.

checks.statement: yes - npm optional package @ccusage/ccusage-linux-x64 (os=linux, cpu=x64); launcher maps linux/x64 to it; release matrix builds it with the musl-static Nix target and CI checks the binary is static; CI E2E runs on ubuntu x64
checks.note: Every sub-claim checks out. (1) package.json:2-4 gives the name and the description 'Static native ccusage binary for Linux x64'; :14-19 gives os [linux], cpu [x64]. (2) cli.js:42-43 returns '@ccusage/ccusage-linux-x64' for linux/x64. (3) release.yaml:64-68 is the build-linux-x64 matrix entry. (4) action.yaml:32,34 runs `nix build .#ccusage-static`, which nix/static-package.nix:38-46 maps to x86_64-unknown-linux-musl. action.yaml:44-56 fails unless ldd/file reports a static binary. (5) ci.yaml:331 runs E2E on blacksmith-32vcpu-ubuntu-2404; it is x64 because it lacks the -arm suffix and is the same label release.yaml:65 uses for the x64 build. The preview publish includes ./packages/ccusage-linux-x64 (ci.yaml:285).

checks.statement: Claude Code: yes - reads JSONL transcripts; `ccusage statusline` is a Claude Code statusLine command reading hook JSON from stdin, offline by default, with a temp-dir output cache; `ccusage blocks` reports 5-hour windows. Codex: data source only (CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex sessions + archived_sessions, --speed auto|standard|fast, labelled experimental). No end-user plugin/hook/skill; .claude/.codex/.agents are contributor config.
checks.citation: rust/adapters/claude/README.md:14-16; rust/adapters/claude/src/paths.rs:23-55; rust/crates/ccusage/src/commands/mod.rs:262-308,310-327,860-877,921-951; docs/guide/statusline.md:17-31; rust/crates/ccusage-cli/src/types.rs:220-224; rust/crates/ccusage-core/src/lib.rs:55; rust/adapters/codex/src/paths.rs:31-64,226-238; rust/adapters/codex/src/README.md:3-11; docs/guide/codex/index.md:5,40,66-83; .claude/AGENTS.md:1-5; .codex/environments/environment.toml:1-17
checks.note: Each part checks out. (1) Claude paths: paths.rs:23-55 uses CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, else $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/claude (default ~/.config/claude) plus ~/.claude, each requiring projects/. (2) Statusline: mod.rs:318-325 parses stdin into StatuslineHook{session_id, transcript_path, model, cost, context_window, effort} (921-951). The docs snippet is a settings.json `statusLine` command (statusline.md:17-31). StatuslineArgs::default sets offline: true (types.rs:223), and the parser uses it (ccusage-cli-parser/src/parser.rs:220). The cache lives at temp_dir()/ccusage-semaphore/<session>.lock (mod.rs:860-877). (3) Blocks: main.rs:34 dispatches to run_blocks, which uses the Claude loader (main.rs:7); DEFAULT_SESSION_DURATION_HOURS = 5.0. (4) Codex: discovers sessions/ and archived_sessions/ under CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex; index.md:5 says 'experimental'; :40 lists --speed auto|standard|fast. (5) No plugin: .claude/AGENTS.md and environment.toml are dev-shell config, and .agents/skills/* are contributor skills (commit, create-pr, fix-ci, ...). No .claude-plugin or marketplace manifest exists, and the npm package ships only src/cli.js and config-schema.json.

checks.statement: Reads Claude Code and Codex local logs and tracks input, output, cache-creation and cache-read tokens separately - verified: yes (Codex cache-creation only when the record carries it; Codex inputTokens is non-cached input)
checks.note: The 'yes' verdict matches the code. (1) Claude: recursive *.jsonl walk (common lib.rs:14-31). TokenUsageRaw has input/output/cache_creation_input/cache_read_input (types.rs:28-39). Cache creation is the 5m+1h breakdown when present (types.rs:41-50). TokenCounts keeps separate counters (types.rs:67-96), as do per-model breakdowns (daily.rs:634-637). Sidechain/copy dedupe is at lib.rs:198-260; advisor iterations at src/README.md:52-61. (2) Codex: token_count events use last_token_usage, else the delta of cumulative totals (parser.rs:318-332). cached_input comes from cached_input_tokens/cache_read_input_tokens/cached_tokens; cache_creation comes only from cache_write_input_tokens/cache_creation_input_tokens; reasoning is a subset of output (types.rs:282-328). inputTokens = non_cached_input_tokens, totalTokens = recorded total (report.rs:64-90,123-129). (3) Docs: cache columns appear on wide (>=100 col) terminals, and the JSON example includes cacheCreationTokens/cacheReadTokens. Minor nit, not an error: the evidence's bare 'README.md:19-42' refers to rust/adapters/claude/src/README.md:19-42 (sidechain dedupe), not the top-level README.
